changelog: Added multi-screen support on a single prop with simultaneous 3D rendering (gas pumps, double-sided kiosks).
Added intuitive 3-mode editing workflow (Translation, Rotation, Scale) with fast and precision speed modifiers.
Reworked studio camera with smooth orbital damping and configurable sensitivity.
Added pre-calibrated gas station pump templates (prop_gas_pump_1d, 1a, 1b, 1c, old2).
